_note: 10 short-form formats for knowledge/education channels. Named by function. 'clip_only' = can be built from one talking-head clip plus graphics; otherwise the skill also writes a shot list for the extra footage and renders a graphic stand-in.

formats.name: Straight Talk
formats.function: One person, one idea, straight to camera.
beats: Hook: a bold or contrarian claim with a number (0-3s)
Body: 3 reasons or steps, one sentence each
Close: one-line takeaway + comment/save CTA
formats.cut_pace: jump-cut every sentence, punch zoom on stressed words

formats.name: Hands-On Explainer
formats.function: Explain while physically doing the task (writing, cooking, fixing, typing).
beats: Hook: hands already mid-task + a question
Body: numbered steps narrated while doing
Close: hold up / show the finished result
formats.broll: the hands-on footage IS the b-roll

formats.name: Backdrop Commentary
formats.function: Speaker in front of a screenshot, headline, chart or article, commenting on it.
beats: Hook: the surprising headline/number on screen
Body: explain what it means
Close: your own take
formats.cut_pace: swap the backdrop at every new point
formats.on_screen: the backdrop carries the text; circle/underline key parts

formats.name: Second Screen
formats.function: A second screen (phone, laptop, another clip) shown next to the speaker, who reacts or teaches from it.
beats: Hook: 'look at this' + the screen
Body: walk through it point by point
Close: the lesson
formats.cut_pace: stacked layout, screen content changes per point
formats.on_screen: label or timer on the second screen

formats.name: Whiteboard Breakdown
formats.function: Draw or write a simple diagram/timeline that builds while you talk.
beats: Hook: first stroke + the question
Body: add one block per point
Close: the full diagram = the conclusion

formats.name: Side-by-Side
formats.function: Compare two options/answers/people next to each other.
beats: Hook: 'A or B?'
Body: A (marked wrong) then B (marked right)
Close: why B wins
formats.cut_pace: split screen, switch sides each point
formats.on_screen: side labels, cross/tick marks, quoted line

formats.name: Do / Don't List
formats.function: Pairs of 'don't say/do X -> do Y instead'.
beats: Hook: 'N things to never...'
Body: each wrong (red) / right (accent) pair pops in
Close: one-line rule
formats.cut_pace: one pair every 3-5s, a new row pops in
formats.on_screen: two-colour table revealing row by row

formats.name: Myth vs Fact
formats.function: Break one widely held wrong belief.
beats: Hook: 'everyone believes X'
Body: why X is wrong (proof/number)
Close: the fact + what to do instead
formats.cut_pace: pace change on the 'but actually' line
formats.on_screen: quoted belief, MYTH / FACT stamps, big phrase captions

formats.name: Tier Ranking
formats.function: Rank several things in the niche into S/A/B/C/D tiers.
beats: Hook: 'Ranking N ... from worst to best'
Body: each item placed in a tier
Close: the top item saved for last
formats.on_screen: coloured tier board above the speaker

formats.name: Field Test
formats.function: Actually try something and report the result.
beats: Hook: 'I tried X for N days/times'
Body: the process + measurements
Close: surprising result + lesson
formats.cut_pace: fast cuts of the real activity, day/counter on screen
